The Trail Blazers defeated the Bucks, 124-114 tonight in Milwaukee. Damian Lillard finished with a team-high 33 points along with 6 rebounds and 5 three pointers for the Trail Blazers, while Scoot Henderson tallied 27 points, 7 rebounds and 5 three pointers in the game. Tyler Herro recorded 19 points, 4 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 10-5 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-15 for the season.
